```{.quiz-yaml}
id: 07_sampling_variability
title: >
  Variability
questions:
  - id: standard_error_n4
    type: numeric
    prompt: >
      A population has standard deviation 15. What is the standard error of the mean
      for samples of size 4?
    answer: 7.5
    tolerance: 0.01
    explanation: >
      The standard error is sigma / sqrt(n) = 15 / sqrt(4) = 7.5.
```
